<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex89022025-05-0511-22-56" status="finalized">dang po la btsad pa ni brjod par rigs tshul 'dra ba la | brjod tshul la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> <expan>la sogs</expan> pa rnams na re dmigs pa dang po ma gtogs <lb n="28a7"/> pas chos 'ba' zhig brjod pas | dmigs pa bcu gcig skyon can gzhan skyon med do zer ro || 
        gnal pa de las bzlog nas nyer gsum po la can zhes pas gzhung la chad par 'dod do || lugs gsum dgag cing 'thad don brjod || 
        
        <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> na re sgra mi rtag ces sam <pb n="28b"/><lb n="28b1"/> sgra'i mi rtag ces pa ni chos brjod dang khyad par gzhan spong gi sgra yin te | chos can sgras khyad par du byas nas chos mi rtag pa brjod pa'i phyir ro || 
        khyab pa'ang sbyor ba skor cig la ltos nas chos la chos can rten par 'gal ba'i phyir ro || 
        mi rtag pa'i sgra byas na chos can brjod pa dang | <lb n="28b2"/> khyad par gzhan mi spong pa'i sgra yin te chos des khyad par byas nas chos can sgra brjod pa'i phyir ro || 
        khyab pa'ang sbyor ba skor cig la chos can chos can la chos rten par mi 'gal ba'i phyir ro || 
        gang ltar yang sgra dang mi rtag pa'i tshogs don rtogs pa la khyad med do || de bzhin gzugs
        <lb n="28b3"/> sogs 'du 'god med byas na chos brjod kyi sgra | 'du 'god med pa'i gzugs sogs byas na chos can brjod pa'i sgra yin te | de gnyis ka ltar na yang de gnyis kyi tshogs don rtogs pa la khyad med do zer ro || </seg></TEI>
source: 3_089_02 legs spyad nyi ma'i 'od zer mtshon cha'i rgyal po.xml
